complete_definition: all 13 core pre-match method_context fields have status ok with source-backed values

second_cycle_context.note: first-cycle pairing+90min and remaining_rounds are schedule-backed; standings/points/chase need a per-round standings source

post_match_labels.note: classified as post-match labels, never pre-match inputs

meeting_number_method: chronological order of the pair’s two scheduled meetings by kickoff datetime; rounds 16-30 do NOT mirror rounds 1-15 in Eliteserien (verified 0/120 mirror rounds), so round number alone cannot establish meeting_number; date ordering is schedule evidence, not score/result derivation
